fusions.name: Strand-Thin Flurry
fusions.desc: Flicks 5 thin cuts out to 3 tiles in a fan, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Split the Finest Line
fusions.desc: A thrust at an enemy up to 4 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Razor-Wire Curtain
fusions.desc: Strings a curtain of fine wire 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it is [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Weave
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
